pa.text:
1. Download the json of the song by pressing 7 on it and saving it or download the mod, go into the files, and get the json
2. Open the json in notepad and copy the contents
3. Open the json handler by showing the json button and clicking it
4. When you get to the part when it asks for the json file, paste the json file into the text box 
5. After the chart is done loading, hide the chart list and delete the json button sprite, the chart converter sprite, and this sprite

Now you're done with charting! :)
